units.text: INT. SEAGULL - CONTINUOUS
TREPLIEFF sits down and begins to cry softly.
Walking up and down in great excitement.
Don’t cry! You mustn’t cry!
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: She bursts into tears.
You really mustn’t.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: She kisses his forehead, his cheeks, his head.
My darling child, forgive me. Forgive your wicked mother.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Embracing her.
Oh, if you could only know what it is to have lost everything under heaven! She does not love me. I see I shall never be able to write. Every hope has deserted me.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Don’t despair. This will all pass. He is going away to-day, and she will love you once more.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: She wipes away his tears.
Stop crying. We have made peace again.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Kissing her hand.
Yes, mother.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Tenderly.
Make your peace with him, too. Don’t fight with him. You surely won’t fight?
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: I won’t, but you must not insist on my seeing him again, mother, I couldn’t stand it.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: TRIGORIN comes in.
There he is; I am going.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: He quickly puts the medicines away in the cupboard.
The doctor will attend to my head.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Looking through the pages of a book.
Page 121, lines 11 and 12; here it is.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: He reads.
“If at any time you should have need of my life, come and take it.”
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: TREPLIEFF picks up the bandage off the floor and goes out.
Looking at her watch.
The carriage will soon be here.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: To himself.
If at any time you should have need of my life, come and take it.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: I hope your things are all packed.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Impatiently.
Yes, yes.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: In deep thought.
Why do I hear a note of sadness that wrings my heart in this cry of a pure soul? If at any time you should have need of my life, come and take it.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: To ARKADINA.
Let us stay here one more day!
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: ARKADINA shakes her head.
Do let us stay!
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: I know, dearest, what keeps you here, but you must control yourself. Be sober; your emotions have intoxicated you a little.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: You must be sober, too. Be sensible; look upon what has happened as a true friend would.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: Taking her hand.
You are capable of self-sacrifice. Be a friend to me and release me!
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: In deep excitement.
Are you so much in love?
units.name: ARKADINA
